integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically by an exact terminal-color characterization and parity pairing strategies, using the published even-minimum-degree palette upper bound. The bundled verifier independently checks finite instances from graph adjacency. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the complete tripartite family K_{1,1,n}; it does not classify arbitrary complete multipartite or split graphs. Finite minimax checks through n=7 are stress tests rather than the proof of the infinite statement.
title: Starting-player parity reversal in the domatic game on \(K_{1,1,n}\)
